Rate-hawk AUD_UP is joining the most extreme FX OI surface in the packet (AUD 99th, AUDCAD/AUDNZD 99.8th). That directional overlay is the crowded idea; the SR1Z26 pay itself is not.

Three-seat outright receive-AU is consensus duration on the housing/RBA story. Pairing it versus pay-CA in CA-AU 2Y is the ownership-asymmetric expression; owning it outright or expressing it in 99th AUD futures is the crowded one.
Do not invent signed CFTC nets or CME OI. MX CORRA OI is null. Paper books are empty $100m seeds. Percentiles remain discovery screens.
